target.title: fix(discord): omit invalid component accent colors
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Discord component messages could serialize an out-of-range numeric container accent color when callers supplied `channelData.discord.components.container.accentColor`.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Discord component serializer now only emits numeric `accent_color` values that fit Discord's 24-bit RGB integer range, while preserving valid hex strings and valid numeric boundary values. This stays inside the Discord component payload boundary and does not change config normalization, message routing, component registration, or valid component behavior.

## User Impact

Discord component messages no longer send invalid numeric container accent colors to Discord. Valid component accent colors continue to serialize normally.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: Discord component message building preserves valid numeric container accent colors and omits out-of-range numeric values before serialization.
- Current-head proof at `7f14d710bdf25e45be339d3ae058674e1e3f1596`: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/discord/src/components.test.ts` passed with 1 file and 18 tests passing.
- Committed diff hygiene: `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode commit --commit HEAD` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Observed result: the focused regression exercises `readDiscordComponentSpec` and `buildDiscordComponentMessage`; `accentColor: 0` serializes as `accent_color: 0`, while `accentColor: 0x1000000` omits `accent_color`.
